title: Priority Combat Input Buffer
description: Create an input buffer that stores combat commands until the character can execute them, while supporting expiry and priority.
requirements: Buffered commands must expire after a configurable duration.
Commands with equal priority must preserve input order.
Invalid commands must be discarded with a reason.
The buffer must have a configurable maximum size.
Executing or discarding a command must remove it exactly once.
constraint: Configuration data and runtime state must use separate types.
stretchGoal: Create an example showing two separate systems consuming the same public API.
